name: tajweed-trainer
description: Interactive tajweed trainer: color-coded Quran text, guided lessons, quizzes, and audio from renowned reciters. Client-only Next.js PWA.

paragraphs: A bilingual (English / Arabic) web app for learning Tajweed, the rules of proper Quran recitation. It pairs nine color-coded lesson modules and practice quizzes with a full 604-page Madinan Mushaf reader, where tapping a verse opens a focused overlay for playback, memorization, notes, and meaning, and a follow-along highlights each word as it is recited. It ships in five art-directed manuscript themes and runs entirely in the browser: no account, no server, and offline as an installed app, with progress kept in localStorage.

The text, the color coding, and the per-verse recitation follow Hafs 'an 'Asim, the most widely used Qira'ah. Quranic text and audio come from established APIs; the rule explanations and examples come from JSON that is reviewed against primary sources before it is marked verified.
